title: WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter + antMatchers is removed in Spring Boot 3 → a SecurityFilterChain bean with requestMatchers
notes: Spring Boot 3 (Spring Security 6) removed WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter — the config becomes a SecurityFilterChain @Bean — and renamed antMatchers/mvcMatchers to requestMatchers. The access-control invariant (/admin requires ADMIN, /public is open, everything else authenticated) must be preserved exactly through the rewrite.
